assets.prompt: Create ONE fictional medieval handwritten signature asset, a real transparent PNG, square 1:1 canvas. Exact readable words on ONE line: "Egon Gafyr". Dark nearly black warm-brown quill ink only, confident firm angular cursive, restrained noble handwriting, distinct tall E and G, a short decisive underline and small finishing flourish. A disciplined military statesman signed this quickly by hand. It must read as an individual signature, not a typeset font and not elaborate decorative calligraphy. Image 1 is a STYLE reference for an isolated handwritten signature on transparency only; do not copy its name or long loops. Position the entire horizontal signature at the middle of the square, occupying around 80 percent of canvas width, no clipped strokes, generous clear margin. No paper, parchment, hand, pen, seal, background, frame, shadow, caption, additional words or watermark. Outside the ink absolutely transparent alpha. Ink lines must remain clear and dark on pale parchment.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square 1:1 fantasy RPG inventory item illustration: ONE official dark oxblood-red sealing wax impression belonging to Sir Egon Gafyr, marshal of Celtigerns Wacht. Reference 1 defines the item's exact DESIGN, materials, colors and any authentic house emblem. Reference 2 defines the ITEM ART STYLE only: hand-painted illustrated fantasy inventory art, painterly textured metal, leather, wood and cloth, crisp dark outlines, soft simplified shading, muted warm colors, gentle illustrated highlights, readable details and a clear silhouette at small thumbnail size. Not photorealistic, not CGI or a glossy 3D render. Preserve the item's design and heraldry from reference 1; never copy the symbols or house colors of the style reference. Show the entire isolated object, centered and large within the square, with about 10% clear margin on all sides. Slight three-quarter view where appropriate; long weapons may run diagonally from lower-left handle to upper-right tip. TRUE transparent PNG alpha background; at most a very faint soft BLACK contact shadow immediately beneath the object. No person, hands, mannequin, scenery, floor, stand, frame, text, watermark or painted checkerboard. Do not add unrelated objects.
Subject: a single round medieval sealing-wax puddle, thick gently irregular scalloped edges, viewed straight on. In its central recessed stamped face are the TWO FACING REARING HORNED GOATS from reference 1, with a small simple Celtic knot below them. Preserve that exact recognizable Gafyr heraldic arrangement, simplified enough to read at tiny icon size. All relief is the SAME DARK RED WAX, highlighted by lighter red ridges, NOT gold or silver paint. A simple circular incised border. Reference 1 defines the Gafyr motif only; reference 2 defines the painted wax-seal rendering and restrained material detail only. No wooden shield, no metallic frame, no ribbon, no string, no parchment, no document, no hand, no letters. Show whole seal centered at 80-85% canvas width with clear transparent margin all around. True transparent PNG; no external halo, no cast shadow or printed backdrop.
